gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: She glanced ___ her watch and stood up.
The government raised the tax ___ cigarettes again.
Three workers were involved ___ the accident.
He's completely serious ___ becoming a chef.
The kids are crazy ___ the new video game.
gaps.explanation: crazy ABOUT something = love it enthusiastically.

gaps.sentence: He spends far too much ___ computer games.
It never occurred ___ me to check the address.
gaps.explanation: it occurred TO somebody = they thought of it.
